blocks.text: Monocytes WBCs (white blood cells) ki aik qism hain aur doosre white blood cells ki tarah bone marrow mein bante hain. Yeh khoon mein gardish karte hain aur interstitial fluid (cells ke darmiyan ka maya) mein bhi chale jate hain. Wahan yeh pukhta (mature) ho kar macrophages ban jate hain. Macrophages microbes ko phagocytose (nigal) kar ke tabah kar dete hain. Yeh aise proteins bhi banate hain jo helper T cells ko fa'al (activate) karte hain. Monocytes doosri qism ke phagocytes mein bhi badalte hain jo liver, spleen, lymph nodes aur doosre tissues mein rehte hain. Yeh cells ka malba (debris) saaf karne aur tissue ke nuqsan ki marammat mein bhi madad dete hain.

blocks.alt: Insani jism ka khaaka jis mein immune system ke aaza: gale mein tonsils aur adenoids, gardan, baghal aur raan ke jor par lymph nodes, inhein jorti lymphatic vessels, seene mein thymus, pet ke baayen taraf tilli (spleen), appendix, aur raan ki haddiyon mein bone marrow.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke monocytes lymphoid tissues mein bante hain. Yeh sahi nahin: monocytes, doosre white blood cells ki tarah, bone marrow ke stem cells se bante hain; kitab khud isi topic ke shuru mein kehti hai ke white blood cells bone marrow mein bante hain. Lymphoid tissues (lymph nodes, spleen) mein yeh baad mein pohanch kar kaam karte hain.
